_comment: Management's PA script. 'text' is both the subtitle and the line to synthesize. kind: rule | announcement | remark | system | ending. takes: ['true'] or ['true','false']; the 'false' take is only used when an ENTITY rule is INVERTED and carries the secret mic-pop tell (docs/SPEC.md 4.5). entity=true marks the one rule per floor that can lie. Tone: warm, dry, polite, institutional. Never threatens, only recommends.
